set(KERNEL_TARGET "build-tta-asic-kernels-5gnr-ldpc")
set(KERNEL_NAME "asic_5gnr_ldpc")
#set(ASIC_ADF_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../../arch/asic_5gnr_ldpc.adf")
#set(ASIC_TPEF_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${KERNEL_NAME}.tpef")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TTA asic architecture/program files
#
# The ADF files are source/input files.
#
# The encode/decode TPEFs are generated by the corresponding child targets:
#
#   build-tta-asic-kernels-5gnr-ldpc-encode
#   build-tta-asic-kernels-5gnr-ldpc-decode
#
# through:
#
#   cores/encode/CMakeLists.txt
#   cores/decode/CMakeLists.txt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(ASIC_ENCODE_ADF_FILE "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/arch/asic_5gnr_ldpc_encode.adf")
set(ASIC_DECODE_ADF_FILE "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/arch/asic_5gnr_ldpc_decode.adf")
set(ASIC_ENCODE_TPEF_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cores/encode/asic_5gnr_ldpc_encode.tpef")
set(ASIC_DECODE_TPEF_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cores/decode/asic_5gnr_ldpc_decode.tpef")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Common LDPC generated files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_property(LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR GLOBAL PROPERTY LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR)
get_property(LDPC_COMMON_N0_TABLE GLOBAL PROPERTY LDPC_COMMON_N0_TABLE)
get_property(LDPC_COMMON_NORMAL_SAMPLES GLOBAL PROPERTY LDPC_COMMON_NORMAL_SAMPLES)

if(NOT LDPC_COMMON_GENERATED_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Common 5G NR LDPC CMake infrastructure was not initialized."
    )
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_ASIC_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_ASIC_HEADERS
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/*.h"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_ASIC_COMMON_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/src/*.cpp"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_TTA_ASIC_COMMON_HEADERS
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/include/*.h"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/common/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/src/*.cpp"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_COMMON_HEADERS
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/targets/common/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/include/*.h"
)
file(
    GLOB_RECURSE LDPC_OSED_SOURCES
    CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${OPENASIP_ROOT}/arch/custom/osal/kernels/5gnr/ldpc/*"
)

list(FILTER LDPC_TTA_SIM_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/temp/")
list(FILTER LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/gen-n0/")
list(FILTER LDPC_COMMON_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/gen-random/")

add_subdirectory(cores/encode)
add_subdirectory(cores/decode)

add_custom_target(${KERNEL_TARGET}) #XXX
